$comment: The AI plugin's native screens, kept in its Apple package (Resources, so Xcode reads it through the plugin manifest symlink) and linked from its Kotlin module (src/android/screens): AI jobs and their status, credits, the hard cap and overage cap, per-member usage, and the staff zones staffOrg and staffUser, the staff AI requests, and the AI spend column the Workspaces list draws (zone staffOrgsListColumn). Routes: /api/ai/jobs, /api/ai/jobs/{id}/cancel and /resume, /api/ai/billing/credits, /api/ai/billing/overage, /api/ai/allotments, /api/ai/usage, /api/ai/admin/org, /api/ai/admin/user (both with view=prepared), /api/ai/admin/credits, /api/ai/admin/conversations and /api/ai/admin/signals. Grammar: docs/mobile/native-architecture.md §13.
